enter_sequence.text: Moreau Pharmaceuticals lab. Glass vials, humming centrifuges, and the sweet rot of bad chemistry.

enter_sequence.speaker: MOREAU
enter_sequence.text: Don't touch the glass. The samples are temperamental — like me.

defeat_sequence.speaker: MOREAU
defeat_sequence.text: I didn't poison the Flats for fun. I perfected a formula. Your people were the proof of concept.

defeat_sequence.speaker: MOREAU
defeat_sequence.text: Every overdose, every shaking hand — that was data. Beautiful, screaming data.

defeat_sequence.speaker: MOREAU
defeat_sequence.text: Kill the doctor and the cure dies with her. Spare me and I'll tell you which batch still walks the streets.

choice_sequence.prompt: Moreau slumps against her bench. What now?

spare_sequence.text: Moreau scribbles batch numbers on a torn label and crawls toward the service lift.

execute_sequence.text: The lab goes quiet. Whatever cure she hid dies with her.
